about.title: Meet Paul Hebert
paragraphs: Paul Hebert has over 30 years of experience in appliance servicing, repairs and sales, going back to his early twenties.
Customers come back for his know-how and for the parts he keeps on hand, which often means a faster fix.
The shop is open Monday through Thursday, 10 to 4. Send a repair request here any time and we'll get back to you.

estimate.title: Tell us what's broken.
estimate.text: Send us the appliance, brand and what's going wrong, and we'll get back to you. Requests come in any time, even when the shop is closed.
estimate.thanks: We got your request and will get back to you soon.
